name: Severing Whisper
description: Whisper a severing word that cuts the foe's thread to their own plan for an instant.

name: Ill-Starred Strike
description: Strike under an ill star so that the blow finds the foe's weakest and unluckiest place.

name: Sutured Thread
description: Stitch the thread of an ally's life back to its fortune so that deep wounds close and strength returns.

name: Fate Gauge
description: Gauge how many threads still bind a foe to their fortune and how soon they will fray.

name: Sundering Lot
description: Throw a lot that sunders the foe's luck and the guard it protects in a single blow.

name: Ruin Foretold
description: Foretell the foe's ruin aloud until they believe it and their strength bends toward it.

name: Undone Fate
description: Undo a curse or a binding laid on an ally or the self by finding the thread that holds it and pulling it free.

name: Thread Aegis
description: Raise an aegis of tight threads that catches the doom aimed at the user and holds it.

name: Cut Destiny
description: Cut the foe's destiny at a single point so that the harm passes through every defense.

name: Fate Reversal
description: Turn a doom aimed at the user back along its thread to fall upon the caster.

name: Fated Seal
description: Seal a foe's fortune shut so that no luck reaches them and every chance fails.

name: Cut Thread
description: Cut the thread that binds the foe to their fortune in the school's closing stroke and let their fate fall slack.

name: Doom Ascendant
description: Raise a doom over the whole field so that it falls on every foe at the full destructive ceiling of its tier and the user is left drained.

name: Terminal Fate
description: Bring one foe to the last turn of their fate in a single blow whose force reaches the ceiling of its tier.

name: Inevitable Touch
description: Touch the foe where the outcome is already settled and press it home.

name: Predestined Guard
description: Stand in the guard that fate has long since ordered for the user.

name: Fortune Restored
description: Restore the fortune of a hurt ally or the self so that wounds close along the likelier road to health.

name: Unfolding Sight
description: See the next several hours unfold and mark the points where they could still change.

name: Decreed Ruin
description: Decree the ruin of a guard and strike so that it falls as decreed.

name: Preordained Veil
description: Draw a veil of preordained safety over the user so that an attack fated to fail is nullified outright.

name: Recalled Fate
description: Recall the fate of an ally whose breath has just stopped to the hour before it failed so that life returns while the short window is open.

name: Decree Binding
description: Decree that a foe shall not move from where they stand and bind them to the decree.

name: Inescapable Doom
description: Cast a doom that cannot be evaded by any means because every escape is already closed.

name: Fate Pardon
description: Grant a pardon from fate to the user and one ally so that a single killing blow is nullified.

name: Verdict Absolute
description: Pass a verdict that seals a foe's fortune into a single outcome which they cannot alter.

name: Fate Inevitable
description: Strike at the outcome the school holds to be certain and make the blow arrive as inevitably as the end of a road.

name: Doom Absolute
description: Bring down the one doom that cannot be turned upon every foe in the field at the full destructive ceiling of its tier.
